author: bridge-bot
content: <amvlasov> Will it be affected by BALs? I think it’ll be easier to witness rlp(BAL) for all initial witness and so on, and plain-hash it, instead of encoding it back. So essentially block witness will only need bytecode hashes/tree hashes preimages (including leaf values), previous block and some CL related data

author: somnergy
content: I would say the BAL doesn't provide the witness, but some hints. They can be useful, but we'd still need the full witness. The indexed pattern of passing still trumps many times over. Then BAL might be helpful in generating this witness and becomes a drag inside the state_transition to validate

author: bridge-bot
content: <amvlasov> I’m only asking in the aspect of BAL being a state diff across transactions, so it should be a witness for initial storage slot values
